pages.title: Life-Giving Waters
pages.text: The $(nile)Nile River$() is the source of all life in the desert. Its banks provide $(item)Fertile Nile Silt$() for farming and $(item)Papyrus Reeds$() for crafting.$(br2)Look for $(item)Lotus Flowers$(), $(item)Algae$(), and $(item)Water Lettuce$() in and around the water.

pages.title: Nile Resources
pages.text: $(li)$(item)Fertile Nile Silt$(): Best farmland$(li)$(item)Nile Mud$(): Building material$(li)$(item)Riverbed Clay$(): Pottery$(li)$(item)Papyrus Reed$(): Paper$(li)$(item)Gold-Flaked Riverbed$(): Gold source$(li)$(item)Lotus Flower$(): Magical item
